notes.title: Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla 1.7 update!
notes.content:
The 3rd game in the [i]Lantern of Worlds[/i] series, [i]Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla[/i], has now been updated to version 1.7!

The new update contains:

- Choose your starting skills!

- Updated lighting

- improved skill screen.

Now, Layla is even better equipped to face the dangers of her adventure, and with your help, will surely win the day and become the Queen of Pirates!

The game is totally free, and can be found here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047190/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30711316/08f4a767b18e6a9f526e36980672afb0586b5540.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hear ye, Hear ye! Grant New Update!
notes.content:
[b]A great new update is now available for Lantern of Worlds![/b]

Not only have all the [b]Maps[/b] been completely redone, the [b]Combat System[/b] has been very much improved as well!

Furthermore, many small improvements and tweaks have been added!

Thanks to everyone for playing, and I sincerely hope you enjoy the new update!

Best regards,

Fabian Schurgers
Fasold Games

notes.title: Mayor update! New enchanted island added!
notes.content:
An entirely new desert island has been added! With a new story, several new locations & items! 
Can you find it? :)

Desert Art by Char Reed. 

Watch out for the desert queen Qadira, and decide the fate of the Oasis Dryad!

notes.title: Mayor New Update! Complete Overhaul Desert Maps!
notes.content:
With this new update the endless desert has been completely overhauled!

Enter a great desert of enhanced beauty and features, and undergo the story of mystery and wonder with a refreshed sense of adventure!!

Many small fixes have also been completed.

Oh, and did I say the game is on sale this entire week? With a fifty percent discount, who can resist an adventure like this? :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30711316/c4d21ed29c548449fe7dd03d99e5450c59263c60.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.4 is now live!
notes.content:
I am very happy to announce that the 1.4 update of Lantern of Worlds is now live!

The most important change is that the game has been remade in a newer version of the engine, increasing smoothness and general stability.

Further changes of this update include:

- Wildlife! Birds and small animals are now present at the tournament!

- A new tournament map, hand painted by Ponylab!

-Fishing! You can now do some sea fishing  on the beaches of the great desert. Who knows what you might catch!

- A new font, the Papyrus font has been replaced.

- A new story, of a shipwreck and a ghostly carpenter.

- And many small tweaks and improvements!
